title: Evaluation of a tabulated source bit
statement: Let $\kappa$ be a finite set of instruction kinds, let $m,w,n$ be nonnegative integers, let $F$ assign to each kind a function from Boolean lists to Boolean lists, let $z$ be a Boolean list, and let $x$ be an assignment of $n$ Boolean inputs. If a list of Boolean vertex values satisfies the tabulation invariant at position $i$, then for every source bit valid at position $i$ relative to the inputs formed by adjoining $z$ to the $n$ input bits and output width $w$, the value at the vertex assigned to that source bit equals its value when evaluated from those inputs and the blocks produced by running the whole program.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ maps each instruction kind and Boolean list to a Boolean list
$x$ is an assignment of $n$ Boolean inputs
the vertex-value list satisfies the tabulation invariant at position $i$
the source bit is valid at position $i$ for input length $|z|+n$ and width $w$
